correctness.rationale: An exact five-class domination-and-exchange equivalence reduces the problem to occupancy counts. A <=5 guard argument excludes group occupancies >=4, forces the two apex-free profiles, and forces four ordinary plus two boundary apex-present profiles. Each is checked against each attack class; a binomial sum counts labelled choices. The argument also proves no secure set of size <=4 and is corroborated by a standalone direct vertex-graph enumeration.

value.rationale: A complete natural infinite two-parameter family is classified at all minimizers, not just a chosen slice: the already known scalar minimum of five has six universal guard placement types and two sharply exceptional size-four types. Exact labelled counts provide structural redundancy information invisible in the scalar invariant; the size-four transition is genuinely qualitative.
